message: `{name}(<...>)` (a port-current probe) may not be used on the left side of `<+` — it is read-only (LRM §5.4.3)
description: A port-current probe `I(<port>)` reads the current flowing into a port. It can be read, but nothing can be contributed to it.
actions: Contribute to a branch instead, for example `I(p, n) <+ ...`.
